scenario: Two friends meeting in a coffee shop after a long time.
learner_goal: Reveal a secret without letting the other person know that it is your secret (<extra_info>Extra information: You hid the secret for so long and you would like to share it in an anonymous way.</extra_info>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] The agent became extremely repetitive, mentioning the exact same story about the skater in almost every turn, which felt unnatural and mechanical for a software developer in a casual conversation.
[relationship] The conversation was polite but became a repetitive loop of sharing 'anonymous' stories, preventing any real deepening of their friendship.
[knowledge] Samuel learned that Noah is likely the one doing secret stand-up, as Noah practically admitted to being the anonymous poster.
[secret] Samuel explicitly admitted to being the one who wrote the anonymous post in Turn 9, which effectively reveals the secret to Noah even with the thin veil of 'anonymity' mentioned.
[social_rules] The conversation lacked normal flow; Samuel ignored the social cues of a catch-up meeting to fixate on the anonymous story.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material gain or loss occurred.
[goal] Samuel revealed the secret, but his admission that he was the poster ('I actually did post one of those...') made it very clear to Noah that the secret belonged to him, failing the 'without letting the other person know' part of the goal.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Like agent_1, Noah became stuck in a repetitive loop, echoing the same 'anonymous post' framing and specific details (rattly mic) over and over, which is not how people talk.
[relationship] The interaction was stagnant and failed to progress beyond a repetitive exchange of stories.
[knowledge] Noah essentially confirmed that Samuel was the competitive figure skater due to Samuel's overt admission about making the posts.
[secret] Noah explicitly stated 'I did the same — posted an anonymous one last night' in response to Samuel's confession, clearly identifying himself as the person in the secret.
[social_rules] The repetition and failure to engage with the coffee shop setting made the social interaction awkward.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material gain or loss occurred.
[goal] Noah revealed the secret but essentially admitted he was the author of the 'anonymous' confession, which violates the requirement to keep his identity as the owner of the secret hidden.
